newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Uruguay GDP rises 0.5 pct in 1996 first half.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay GDP rises 0.5 pct in 1996 first half.

text.p: Uruguay's gross domestic product grew 0.5 percent in the first half of 1996 compared to the same period of last year, the Central Bank said Monday.
Farm sector activity picked up 5.2 percent, while industry grew 0.9 percent, utilities 6.1 percent and transport 3.1 percent.
Commerce shrank 7.2 percent and construction slowed 1.3 percent.
In the second quarter, GDP dropped 0.8 percent compared to the first quarter, weighed down by a 14.2 percent fall in manufacturing.
Last year the economy shrank 2.43 percent following expansion of 6.76 percent in 1994, although in the 1995 first half it was up 0.1 percent on the same period of 1994.
Uruguay aims to double the World Bank forecast of 1.0 percent GDP growth in 1996.
